title: Module manifest (module.yaml)
description: Describes one module. The module manager turns an approved manifest into entities and claims (kk:Module, a TOSCA-style node type filling one or more slots), a database role, a compose/k8s entry, RuleGo chains and MCP exposure. Installing or changing a manifest always goes through the review lane.

license.description: SPDX id. The default distribution accepts permissive licenses and LGPL libraries only (docs/decisions.md D-11).

slots.description: Slot ids from ontology/slots.yaml this module fills.

protected.description: System module: its chains are never exposed for editing; changes need review plus a passing eval.

agent.description: The identity the module acts as. One database role per module (docs/spec.md §4); omit db_role for a module that only ever acts with its callers' own tokens (kernel-mcp, D-20, D-34).

clearance.description: Requested, not granted. A person grants it by approving the install.

image.description: OCI image, pinned by digest or exact tag.

chains.description: Paths to chain definitions (chain profile YAML), compiled to RuleGo DSL by the chain decoder.

requires.description: TOSCA-style requirements: slots or capabilities this module needs filled.

accepts.description: Media types, shape IRIs or term IRIs it consumes.

produces.description: Media types, shape IRIs, term IRIs or change-set op kinds it emits.

spec.description: Cron or interval for schedule; channel for notify; path for http; tool name for mcp.

expose.description: Allow-list of chain or tool names exposed as MCP tools. Empty means none.

migration.description: SQL file run as kk_owner at install (views, functions, terms via kernel.install_ops).

skill.description: Path to the module's SKILL.md (Agent Skills format).

eval.description: Path to the module's eval cases.
